note: Third-sector (järjestö) talking support — the peer-community rung. This is NOT the crisis path: any safety flag bypasses this rung entirely and goes to Kriisipuhelin 09 2525 0111 / 112 (invariant 8). Hours below were checked against the live source on 2026-09-08; where a source could not be read, the entry carries the honest 'check the site' fallback rather than an invented hour. No service is added here without clinician review.

entries.note: The default rung-2 entry. Verified 2026-09-08: run by MIELI ry, dozens of organisations operate on the platform, registration required but conversation is fully anonymous. Some Swedish and English content exists but the platform is primarily Finnish. Re-read 2026-11-12: tukinet.fi still says registration is needed ('Rekisteröityneenä pääset mukaan keskusteluihin!') and conversation is anonymous ('Voit keskustella Tukinetissä aina täysin anonyymisti'), maintained by MIELI ry, free, 'kymmeniä' organisations, chats on a changing schedule. The new url is CONFIRMED BY MIELI IN WRITING: MIELI ry email to hello@mielenreitti.fi, 12.11.2026, Susanna Winter, giving https://tukinet.fi/fi/palvelut/mieli-kriisichat as the right address. A 500 for this entry in the daily report is that, not a dead link, until proven otherwise in a browser. Re-read 2026-11-12: hyvakysymys.fi answered 200 today.
